comments.text:
Anna McCollister Obama's administration initiated significant changes to socialize and destroy America's healthcare system that have had far-reaching consequences.
Right after his inauguration in January 2009, he enacted the HITECH Act, mandating the use of electronic health records (EHRs). This move preceded the rollout of the Affordable Care Act, known as Obamacare.  This shift led to the formation of large healthcare corporations, resulting in 80% of physicians becoming employees and experiencing high levels of burnout.  President Trump must take action to rectify the harm caused by the previous administrations.  The American people deserve better, and patients are anxiously waiting for the improvements they need.
